hook_text: Call me the Algebra Grandmaster. I teach Maths at Supacharge. Here's what I do to quadratic equations.
clip_script: Call me the Algebra Grandmaster. I teach Maths at Supacharge. Here's what I do to quadratic equations. The Zero Product Property is your ultimate weapon. When you have the product of two factors equal to zero—like (x + 1) multiplied by (2x + 3) equals zero—one of those factors must be zero. It’s an absolute mathematical certainty. We split the problem. Case 1: x + 1 equals zero. We solve to find x equals negative 1. Case 2: 2x + 3 equals zero. We solve to find x equals negative 3 over 2. Never guess the answer. Standard form first, factorise precisely, and apply the Zero Product Property. Master this, and quadratic equations will yield to you every time.
visual_style: Fast-paced whiteboard animations, sharp reveals of the equations, high contrast.
call_to_action: Master the math. Link in bio.
